sylvie: Quick question about audit propagation for model anchors — should anchor/ pin annotations be copied to rollout events or just referenced?
ishaan: My gut: reference only, copy causes duplication and drift. But ops wants a snapshot for post-mortem.
marco: +1 on reference. but we should have an immutable snapshot attached to rollout records (not mutate model metadata).
sylvie: ok that feels reasonable. concretely: rollout record should include a compact snapshot of the pin metadata at time-of-rollout. e.g. 
```
rollout.metadata_snapshot:
  pinned_model: "redwood/alpaca-v2-1"
  pin_origin: "commit-9f2a"
  pin_semantics: "soft-affinity"
  pin_ttl: "36h"
```
Would that satisfy ops?
ops-bot: new ticket created: INFRA-1298 for rollout snapshot retention and export. :ticket:
ishaan: A couple tradeoffs: size and privacy. snapshots can grow if we include provenance chains. propose we only include fields from the canonical pin schema: model_id, origin, mode, ttl, fingerprint. full provenance lives in model history.
marco: Agree. Also add a boolean `snapshot_truncated` if provenance length > 1. That way consumers know why they don't see the full chain.
sylvie: good call. also need a migration plan for existing rollouts that have no snapshot. do we backfill from archive?
ishaan: backfill best-effort from model-history table for last 90 days. mark backfilled=true. Anything older, leave null and surface as unknown.
marco: For the API surface: rollout GET should return the snapshot object and also a `pin_reference` pointing to model metadata id. Example response: 
```
{
  "id": "rollout-2023-10-25-42",
  "pin_snapshot": { /* compact fields */ },
  "pin_reference": "model:meta:abcd1234",
  "backfilled": false
}
```
This keeps clients able to reconcile.
sylvie: what about client behavior if they read rollout.snapshot vs reading live model pins? Which wins?
ishaan: Contract: snapshot is the source-of-truth for that rollout's historical decision. live model pins are authoritative for current routing. We should document that clearly.
marco: add a server-side check: when a rollback happens, include both the original snapshot and the new rollback snapshot. history is append-only.
sylvie: action items: 1) infra ticket INFRA-1298 (ops-bot) 2) api doc patch (ishaan) 3) backfill job spec (marco) 4) docs note about snapshot vs live (sylvie)
ops-bot: INFRA-1298 assigned to @ops-team, priority P2. Backfill ticket created: DATA-404.
ishaan: I'll draft the API PR today and link INFRA-1298.
marco: I'll write the backfill spec and the truncated-flag semantics.
sylvie: thanks. if no objections I'll mark this design agreed and file a lightweight RFC follow-up. :thumbsup:
ishaan: no objections from me.
marco: same.
ops-bot: design agreed label applied to INFRA-1298 by @sylvie at 1698204720 GMT
